newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling steady against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling steady against the dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling was almost unchanged against the dollar on Wednesday in a stable market, foreign exchange dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.88 against the dollar from 54.89 on Tuesday. Against the pound, the shilling posted at a mean rate of 89.83 from 90.
"We're seeing normal activity from both sides with nothing major happening to move the shilling," one dealer said.
Another dealer said that the market had absorbed a lot of demand last week -- the most probable reason for low demand seen this week since Tuesday.
"Whatever supply is coming in from the weekly coffee and tea sales is not enough to cause a major market movement," another dealer added.
The money market remained liquid with overnight rates quoted below 10 percent levels on Wednesday unchanged.
